criteria: Psoriatic arthritis: failed a 3-month trial of a conventional DMARD (e.g. methotrexate or leflunomide) AND inadequate response, contraindication, or intolerance to adalimumab (Amjevita preferred, Humira).

Ankylosing spondylitis or nonradiographic axial spondyloarthritis: inadequate response, contraindication, or intolerance to infliximab AND to adalimumab (Amjevita preferred, Humira) AND to full-dose NSAID taken 4+ weeks.
Peripheral spondyloarthritis with documented enthesitis/tendonitis.

Peripheral SpA, no enthesitis/tendonitis: 3-month nonbiologic DMARD trial (sulfasalazine, methotrexate, leflunomide) AND inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication to adalimumab (Amjevita, Humira).

Plaque psoriasis: moderate to severe (>3% body surface area unless palmar-plantar involvement is severe) AND inadequate response or contraindication to 3-month phototherapy (unless sensitive areas) AND failed 3-month methotrexate or acitretin trial (unless adverse effect/contraindication) AND inadequate response to preferred anti-TNF (Amjevita or Inflectra) after 3 months.
